training_selection: unique normalized groups assigned train by unchanged Phase 2 seed-17 hash rule, from the bounded source prefix
development_selection: unchanged original 105 development stories; no new development groups used
final_selection: unchanged original 120 reserved stories; encode only after both complete training artifacts are fixed
tokenizer: unchanged 512-entry training-only Phase 2 tokenizer; no refit
checkpoint_selection: predeclared last update 2000 in each condition; no final-set selection or adaptive extension
primary_question: How do 64 versus 128 supplied input slots affect fixed-budget prediction loss and measured training resources?
primary_comparison: last checkpoints, same seed/initial state, scored chunks/row draws/true-target budget/optimizer schedule; same parameter count
context_policy: 64 disjoint scored targets, with up to context-64 additional story-local warm-up inputs; not a separate maximal window for every target
secondary_reference: alpha-0.1 count bigram fit on exactly the expanded training stories; historical Phase 2 learned bigram separately labeled
evaluation_precision: FP32 forward and per-token loss; float64 sums; no temperature/top-k filtering in likelihood
sample_prompts: Mia found a small red box.
Tom wanted to help his friend.
The little bird was afraid of the rain.
Sara could not find her toy.
One morning, a rabbit saw a bright light.
generation_metrics: duplicate fraction of word trigrams in continuation only
review_scale: 1 poor, 2 weak, 3 mixed, 4 good, 5 strong; real reviewer identity required
human_review: unfilled forms are pending, not human evidence; assistant qualitative observations must be labeled
uncertainty: one paired training seed; descriptive paired story bootstrap reflects story sampling, not training-seed uncertainty
holdout_policy: one fixed evaluation of the frozen final artifacts; no tuning or additional training based on these results
paper_status: university research draft; no novelty, publication acceptance or statistically established general superiority claim
